  process=cold-forming  [small aluminium part at 100,000/yr — cold forging gives near-100% material yield, work-hardened strength and a machined-quality finish with no flash [tolerance class, safety-critical assumed — confirm before quoting] — deterministic, use verbatim]
  projectedAreaCm2=288.4  [parting-plane silhouette: bbox face × √fill for a solid, bbox face for a shell — deterministic, use verbatim]

  yieldFraction=0.915  [cold-forming stock yield band 0.85–0.98, midpoint 0.915 — this route makes no flash — deterministic, use verbatim]
  flashAndScaleKg=0  [cold-forming has no impression parting line — it makes no flash; the stock loss is inside the yield band — deterministic, use verbatim]
  forgeId=forge-press-1600t  [F = Kt × σflow × A: moderate shape in aluminium over 288.4 cm² = 809 t (1.2 safety) — deterministic, use verbatim]
